title: 01_baseline_parity
interpretation: At-rest baseline (no infection): the real BioGears 8.2.0 engine and the SBML extraction settle to the same StandardMale haemodynamics — SBP 114.9 vs 114.6 mmHg, DBP 74.5 vs 73.5, HR 72.2 vs 71.5 /min, cardiac output 5.81 vs 5.9 L/min — all within ~1 mmHg / ~0.7 bpm / ~0.1 L/min of each other and of the StandardMale target (y-axes zoomed to the target band so the small differences are visible). This is the parity gate: because both sides start from the same state, the divergence measured under infection in studies 02-03 is attributable to the model, not a mismatched starting point. Values are the committed severity-0 run results (engine 5 min, SBML 30 s).
